note: Distilled finished CS2 matches: id, UTC start, team ids, winner id, best-of, tier, and the last bookmaker price pair published by bo3.gg for that match. Caution: for finished matches that pair is the last price the provider held, which is updated in-play, so it is NOT used as a market benchmark (measured 2026-10-14: it implies the eventual winner in 100% of 4,000 settled matches).
